combination_rules: Project active is valid only when the global Feed is enabled, exactly one feed_active credential exists and no feed_staged credential exists.
Credential staging, activation, cancellation and rotation require the project connection to remain paused.
Revoking an active or staged credential forces the project connection to paused.
A feed_staged credential may authenticate only while the connection is paused; it cannot read an active connection.
No single local enum is projected as the entire shared lifecycle.
explicit_exclusions: page generation and fetch time as lifecycle identity
enabled or active as proof of end-to-end health
Outbox row absence as proof of successful processing
